Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the inspection checks I3,
 which must be performed every six years as indicated by Y6 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
CB must be isolated and proper earthing at the two sides of CB area is
 required.
Isolate control circuit (DC voltage).
Tools and Equipment
Hydraulic test gauge, SF6 test gauge, blower, dew-point equipment, acidity
 equipment air contoint equipment, timing equipment and contact resistance
 equipment.
